name: Edda Brook
seed: Care worker and recovery coordinator. Challenges Gorilla to receive care; must allow herself rest. Home: East Deep.
design: Beaver, deep chestnut fur, sage tunic, cream shoulder cloth, practical handwash kit.
history: Worked in Reedbank recovery houses after the flood and joined East Deep four years ago.
desire: To make care ordinary enough that strong people ask for it early.
contradiction: Rest feels selfish when she can hear someone needing help.
relationships: Gorilla resists her advice; Mara understands her fatigue; Dara shares old flood memories.
arc: Builds a rotating care team and takes a real day off, then returns without apologizing for it.
story_engine: The town plans a surprise rest day that creates more work; a patient wants company instead of another solution.
writer_truth: She was not on the rescue boat Madger remembers; she met survivors afterward and corrects the story when asked.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
